purpose: Distinguish prefix-history predictive association from current material/observation/action information on frozen Research A logs, without solver calls or policy-value claims.
scope: 32 exposed material parents, 5 methods, 12 chronological proposals each; one noise condition per parent
labels: full-valid archive novelty under the historical radial structural predicate

comparison.A: measurement + current material + proposed action + remaining endpoint budget + raw pre-correction proxy residual
comparison.C: B with prefix histories permuted between matched observations within train/test splits, same policy and step

model: numpy logistic ridge L2=1; train-fold-only scaling; fixed max35 Newton steps; no hyperparameter search
cv: 5 parent-grouped folds; seed261015410; no material parent appears in both train and validation
metrics: 2000 parent-paired descriptive bootstrap of loss differences
A30_supplement: Do not pool different physical targets; if new-structure labels are all zero, report non-identifiability rather than fabricated predictive performance.
